moments.title: Premier League Kicks Off 2026/27 Season
moments.blurb: The 2026/27 Premier League season officially begins this Friday, August 21st, with defending champions Arsenal hosting newly-promoted Coventry City.

angles.name: Opening Weekend Buzz
angles.copy: Football is BACK! The Premier League season kicks off this weekend. Who are you backing for glory, and who's facing an early relegation scrap?

angles.copy: Arsenal vs Coventry City lights up Friday night as the Premier League returns! Can the champions start strong against the Championship winners?
